rules: First matching row wins; `class` names the Reference-side member class. A behavior-note row is a deliberate, documented divergence. An open-bead row is a known bug: it must be removed when the bead lands, because an unmatched open-bead row fails the diff.

exclusions.subject: brace
exclusions.reason: Brace is a parametric path family, not a stretched \underbrace glyph render (BN-08 table). Its root is the drawn path, not a container of glyph children.

exclusions.subject: decimal_number
exclusions.reason: DecimalNumber is native text through Scribe with a per-character glyph cache (BN-08, 'Why DecimalNumber is a cache'). Each digit is one glyph submobject, not a Text wrapping a glyph path, so the family is one level shallower.

exclusions.subject: annulus
exclusions.reason: The Reference builds each Annulus circle with quadratic_bezier_points_for_arc(TAU), whose default is 8 components (35 points). FrankenManim applies BN-09's one arc-density rule, 16 components for a full circle (67 points). bbox stays compared.
